name: regex_tool
description: Test, match, and apply regular expressions against text or files. Useful for pattern extraction and text transformation.

text.description: Text to match against (or file path if action=file)

manual.overview: Use when you need to match, extract, or replace patterns in text. Essential for parsing logs, URLs, or structured data.
tips: Test patterns on small samples before running on large text
Use findall for extraction, replace for transformation
edge_cases: Catastrophic backtracking can hang on complex patterns with long input
Replace with capture groups uses \1 syntax; backslashes need escaping in JSON

executor.command: python -c "import re, json, sys; pattern=r'{{args.pattern}}'; text='''{{args.text}}'''; matches=re.findall(pattern, text); print(json.dumps(matches, indent=2))"
